about: Board Race tasks per level. kind 'forms': items with matching answers (shown on Reveal). kind 'list': write as many as you can; examples shown on Reveal. M.1 verb forms and basic vocabulary, M.2 vacation words and past continuous, M.3 idioms and collocations. Written for Kru. At least 50 per level, shuffled every game.

intro.title: Board Race
text: Each team lines up at the whiteboard.

intro.title: One answer each
text: The first student writes ONE answer.
Then pass the pen to the next student in your line.

intro.title: Win points
text: Correct answers win points for your team.

before.name: Golden letter U
before.text: Answers with the letter U count double!

before.name: Double points
before.text: Every correct answer is worth 2 this round!

before.name: Silent line
before.text: No talking in the line! A silent team gets +2.

secret.name: Long answers
secret.text: +1 for every answer with 8 letters or more!

secret.name: Capital letters
secret.text: +2 if your team used capital letters correctly.

secret.name: Fastest team
secret.text: +2 for the team that finished first!

secret.name: Unique answer
secret.text: +1 for every answer no other team wrote!
